questions.question: If 5(x + 1) = 25, what is the value of x + 1?
questions.explanation: Dividing both sides by 5 gives x + 1 = 5.

questions.question: The graph of the linear function y = f(x) + 13 is shown. If c and d are positive constants, which equation could define f?
questions.explanation: The graph has y-intercept 3 and a negative slope, so f(x) + 13 = 3 − cx and f(x) = −10 − cx, which has the form −d − cx.

questions.question: For a particular tree species, it is recommended to plant a maximum of 102 trees per acre. Based on this recommendation, what is the maximum number of trees of this species that can be planted on 3 acres?
A length of 450 meters is equal to how many decimeters? (1 meter = 10 decimeters)
questions.explanation: Multiply by 10 decimeters per meter: 450 × 10 = 4500.

questions.question: Carmen needs at least 100 signatures to submit a petition. If Carmen already has 51 signatures, what is the minimum number of additional signatures Carmen needs to submit the petition?
questions.explanation: She needs 100 − 51 = 49 more signatures.

questions.question: A bank account was opened with an initial deposit. Over the next several months, regular deposits were made into this account, and there were no withdrawals made during this time. The graph of the function f shown, where y = f(x), estimates the account balance, in dollars, in this bank account x months since the initial deposit. To the nearest whole dollar, what is the amount of the initial deposit estimated by the graph?
questions.explanation: The initial deposit is the balance at x = 0, which is the y-intercept, 30.

questions.question: Line segment GH and point R are shown in the xy-plane. If line ℓ (not shown) contains point R and is perpendicular to line segment GH, which of the following is an equation of line ℓ?
Which expression is equivalent to 15y8, where y > 1?
questions.explanation: Since 1/y^8 = y^−8, the expression 1/(5y^8) equals y^−8/5.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to 2(x − 72)(x + 6)?

x2 = 2,601
How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?
questions.explanation: x = 51 or x = −51, two distinct real solutions.

questions.question: The equation y = −4.9(x − 8.9)2 + 12,400 gives the estimated height above ground, y, in meters, of a plane, where x is the number of seconds since it started a parabolic maneuver. If this equation is graphed in the xy−plane, which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph?
options: The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 12,400 meters 4.9 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 12,400 meters 8.9 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 4.9 meters 12,400 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 8.9 meters 12,400 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
questions.explanation: The vertex is (8.9, 12,400); since the coefficient is negative it is a maximum, 12,400 m at x = 8.9 s.

questions.question:
x2 − 2x − 18 = 0
One solution to the given equation can be written as 1 + √k, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Complete the square: (x − 1)^2 = 19, so x = 1 ± √19 and k = 19.

questions.question:
y = x − c
y = −4(x − 8)2
In the given system of equations, c is a constant. The system has two distinct real solutions. Which of the following could be the value of c?
questions.explanation: Setting the expressions equal gives 4x^2 − 63x + 256 − c = 0. Two real solutions require 63^2 − 16(256 − c) > 0, so c > 127/16 ≈ 7.94; of the choices only 13 works.

questions.question: What is the 90% of 80?
Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which data set has the greatest mean?
questions.explanation: A, B and D each have mean 75, while C is weighted toward larger values: (60 + 140 + 240 + 360)/10 = 80.

questions.question:
f(x) = 29
For the given linear function f, which table gives three values of x and their corresponding values of f(x)?
questions.explanation: Since f(x) = 29 for every x, the table must show 29 for every x value.

questions.question: Jasmin grows bean pods in her garden. This year, she harvested 490 bean pods and saved 10% of them to plant next year. How many of the harvested bean pods did Jasmin save to plant next year?

A company that produces only one type of item wants to estimate the percent of the items produced in a typical week that are defective. A random sample of 400 of the items produced in a certain week were tested. Based on the sample, it is estimated that 8.5% of all items produced by the company in this week are defective, with an associated margin of error of 2.73%. Based on the estimate and associated margin of error, which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion about all items produced by the company during this week?
options: It is plausible that between 5.77% and 11.23% of the items are defective.
It is plausible that more than 11.23% of the items are defective.
questions.explanation: 8.5% ± 2.73% gives the plausible interval 5.77% to 11.23%.

questions.question: Circle N has a radius of 6 millimeters (mm). Circle M has an area of 121π mm<sup>2</sup>. What is the total area, in mm<sup>2</sup>, of circles N and M?
questions.explanation: Area of N = 36π; total = 36π + 121π = 157π.

questions.question: In the right triangle shown, what is the value of tan A?
questions.explanation: Angle C is 30°, so angle A is 60° and tan A = tan 60° = √3 ≈ 1.732.

questions.question: In a right triangle, one of the acute angles has a measure of θ, and sin(θ) = 4/5. What is the value of cos(90° - θ)?

A property owner wants to find the length x, in feet, across a pond as represented in the figure. PR intersects ST at point Q, and angle PTQ is congruent to angle RSQ. The lengths represented by PQ, TQ, QS, and RS were determined to be 4,200 feet, 8,400 feet, 1,400 feet, and 1,600 feet, respectively. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Triangles PTQ and RSQ are similar, with TQ/SQ = 8,400/1,400 = 6. So x = 6 × 1,600 = 9,600.

questions.question: 2.5c + 5d = 60. The given equation describes the relationship between the number of cats, c, and the number of dogs, d, that can be cared for at a pet care business during a week. If the business cares for 12 dogs during a week, how many cats can it care for during this week?

Each 3.0-ounce serving of cheddar cheese and each 1.2-ounce serving of tuna provides about 1 microgram of vitamin B12. If a total of 3.6 micrograms of vitamin B12 are consumed from eating x ounces of cheese and y ounces of tuna, which equation best represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Cheese provides 1/3.0 ≈ 0.33 microgram per ounce and tuna provides 1/1.2 ≈ 0.83 microgram per ounce, so 0.33x + 0.83y = 3.6.

questions.question: What is the slope of the graph of y = 12(15x + 12) + 3x in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: y = 7.5x + 6 + 3x = 10.5x + 6, so the slope is 10.5.

questions.question: A linear model estimates the population of a city from 1992 to 2016. The model estimates the population was 51 thousand in 1992, 225 thousand in 2012, and x thousand in 2016. To the nearest whole number, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The rate is (225 − 51)/20 = 8.7 thousand per year, so x = 225 + 4(8.7) = 259.8 ≈ 260.

questions.question: The function w is defined by w(r) = (1)/(r − 2) − (r − 9)/(−r + 5.25). What is the greatest possible value of r such that w(r) = 0?
questions.explanation: Setting the terms equal and cross-multiplying gives 5.25 − r = (r − 9)(r − 2), so r^2 − 10r + 12.75 = 0 and r = 1.5 or 8.5. The greatest is 8.5.

questions.question:
17.5x + 28.75y = 530

Odalys ordered much and river rock, which cost a total of $530, for her home. The given equation represents the relationship between the number of cubic yards of much, x, and the number of tons of river rock, y, Odalys ordered. How much more, in dollars, did a ton of river rock cost Odalys than a cubic yard of much?

Line j is defined by 4x + 5y = 55. Line k is parallel to line j in the xy-plane. An equation of line k is 24x + ry = 15, where r is a constant. If line k passes through the point (0, b), what is the value of b?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have equal slopes: −4/5 = −24/r, so r = 30. Then 30b = 15 and b = 1/2.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to 42x3 + 7x?
questions.explanation: Factor out 7x: 42x^3 + 7x = 7x(6x^2 + 1).

questions.question: For a polynomial function f, the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane contains the points (−6, 0), (7, 0), (0, 0), and (4, 0). Which of the following must be a factor of f(x)?
questions.explanation: The zeros 0 and 7 give factors x and (x − 7), whose product is x^2 − 7x.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (5x<sup>3</sup> − 3x + 8) − (9x<sup>6</sup> + 5x − 3)?
questions.explanation: Distribute the negative: −9x^6 + 5x^3 − 3x − 5x + 8 + 3 = −9x^6 + 5x^3 − 8x + 11.

questions.question:

In the given equation, p > 1 and t > 1. If t = p2n − 1, where n is a constant, what is the value of n?

f(x) = −(x − 6)2 + 4
The function f is defined by the given equation. For what value of x does f(x) reach its maximum?
questions.explanation: The leading coefficient is negative, so the vertex (6, 4) is the maximum, which occurs at x = 6.

questions.question:
178x2 + (s − 178t)x − st = 0
In the given equation, s and t are positive constants. The product of the solutions to the given equation is −2kst, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: The product of the solutions is c/a = −st/(1/78) = −78st. Setting −78st = −2kst gives k = 39.

questions.question: The positive number a is 2,047% of the sum of the positive numbers b and c, and b is 89% of c. What percent of b is a?

f(x) = 8(2)(x/4)
Which table gives four values of x and their corresponding values of f(x) for the given exponential function?

The histogram summarizes a data set of the weights, in pounds, of 14 salmon. If an additional weight of 85 pounds is added to the original data set to create a new data set of 15 weights of salmon, which of the following measures must be greater for the new data set than for the original data set?
I. The median
II. The mean
questions.explanation: Adding a value larger than every other value always raises the mean. The old median (average of the 7th and 8th values) and the new median (the 8th value) both fall in the 15–20 bin and could be equal, so the median need not increase.

questions.question: In a certain state, the population of pheasants, a type of bird, is estimated each year by counting the number of pheasants observed along certain roads in the state. On average, each year from 2005 to 2015 the number of pheasants counted per mile of road decreased by 3.5% of the number of pheasants per mile of road the previous year. Based on this average, if there were 6.97 pheasants per mile of road in this state in 2005, which of the following best approximates the number of pheasants per mile of road in 2015?
questions.explanation: A 3.5% yearly decrease multiplies by 0.965 each year for 10 years: 6.97(0.965)¹⁰.

questions.question: Two lines intersect. One angle measures (5x − 8)° and the angle vertical to it measures (3x + 20)°. What is the value of x?
In triangle ABC, angle B is a right angle, and the length of BC is 248 millimeters. If cos(A) = 35, what is the length, in millimeters, of AB?
questions.explanation: cos A = 3/5 makes the sides 3 : 4 : 5 for AB : BC : AC. BC = 248 = 4 × 62, so AB = 3 × 62 = 186.

questions.question: In triangle XYZ, the measure of angle X is x°, the measure of angle Y is y°, and the measure of angle Z is 31°. If x > y > 31, which of the following additional pieces of information is NOT sufficient to determine the values of x and y?
questions.explanation: The angle sum gives x + y = 149. Choices A, B and C each give a second independent equation, but 31 − 3x − 3y = 31 − 3(149) is always the same number, so it adds no new information.

The table gives the areas and perimeters of two similar rectangles, where n is a constant. What is the value of n?
questions.explanation: The area ratio is 2,640/660 = 4, so the scale factor is 2. Perimeters scale by 2, so n = 2 × 220 = 440.
